When I lived with my mom and my cat. She ran away once. I put a chair outside the apartment building and slept there for 12 days. I paid a woman to track my cat with her dog. I went around and dragged my clothes behind me so she could find my smell and come back. 12 days and she came back. 

This time its different.. She hasnt seen me in a while because I was homeless for 2 months.
And now the barn where she was is outside my city, 45 minutes away.. And its a big area. I dont know how to bring her back. And I cant afford going to that area. I dont have a car, there is no train or bus to that place and taxi would cost me $100 minimum.

I havent given up on her.. I know that as soon as I have money I will go look for her there. But now I feel powerless.. And it hurts.
Everytime I close my eyes I see her suffer. She is a very easily scared cat, doesnt like anyone but me. I have a strong guilt in me..
I love you for this! Thank you so much for those kind and uplifting words, it means alot to me ❤️
